import anndata as ad
    
    
import pandas as pd

adata = ad.io.read_mtx(filename='/corral4/main/objects/2/8/3/dataset_283acb30-2542-4da9-b706-bc8e866933e2.dat')
adata = adata.transpose().copy()

obs = pd.read_csv('/corral4/main/objects/e/d/c/dataset_edc37397-1c82-450e-860b-30d68d2dbabb.dat', sep='\t', index_col=0)
var = pd.read_csv('/corral4/main/objects/1/b/f/dataset_1bf20150-295d-414c-9f0c-c855b02c2878.dat', sep='\t', index_col=0)

if adata.shape[0] != obs.shape[0]:
    raise ValueError(f"Mismatch: adata has {adata.shape[0]} cells, but obs has {obs.shape[0]} rows.")

if adata.shape[1] != var.shape[0]:
    raise ValueError(f"Mismatch: adata has {adata.shape[1]} genes, but var has {var.shape[0]} rows.")


adata.obs = obs
adata.var = var

adata.write_h5ad('anndata.h5ad', compression='gzip')
print(adata)
